what: Her body's paintable regions for P1's UV layout and B3's painted-block maps (L1 art director, v1, 4 Nov; B3's spec confirms it after G1)

derived_from.need: the play camera (her 40-60 px tall), the close-up at its closest zoom and the Look camera: the band (cel ramp) must read big forms; painted light needs straight, evenly scaled islands
derived_from.reference: look_l1/a2/r2/MB1_her (skin: two tones, a warm terminator band, a cool colored shade, small hard highlights; no pores or blotches)

uv_rules.symmetry: mirror left/right on the body's center line (a painted half mirrors clean); the face island's axis on the center
uv_rules.seams: inner arms, inside legs, under the hairline, behind the ears, under her outfits' permanent lines; never across the face, the decolletage or the belly
uv_rules.limbs: islands straightened along the limb so the brush and the gradients run along U or V
uv_rules.region_id_map: bake a region ID map (one flat color per region, the ids below) at the body texture's size, so B3 applies each region's rules as data

regions.name: face
regions.covers: front of the head: brow to chin, ear to ear, eyes, nose, lips

regions.name: scalp
regions.covers: back and top of the head under the hair

regions.name: neck_decolletage
regions.covers: neck front and sides, collarbones, upper chest to the top of the breasts (always seen in her outfits)

regions.name: torso_front
regions.covers: breasts, ribs, belly to the hip line

regions.name: torso_back
regions.covers: nape to the small of the back, shoulder blades

regions.name: upper_arms
regions.covers: shoulders to elbows, left and right

regions.name: hands
regions.covers: hands and fingers, nails as their own material

regions.name: thighs
regions.covers: hip line to above the knee

regions.name: lower_legs
regions.covers: knees, shins, calves to the ankle
